description.narrative:
OHCHRs work plan revolves around six strategic pillars that define the agency's operations and main objectives in Colombia. Namely:
- Strengthening rule of law and accountability for human rights violations
- Enhancing and Protecting Civic Space and Peoples Participation
- Pillar: Enhancing equality and countering discrimination
- Integrating human rights in sustainable development
- Early warning, prevention and protection of human rights in situations of conflict and insecurity
- Increasing implementation of the international human rights mechanisms` outcome

Sveriges regering har bekräftat sitt stöd för verksamheten vid FN:s högkommissarie för mänskliga rättigheter i Colombia (2017-2021) med ett totalt bidrag på 62 600 000 SEK. Det övergripande målet för insatsen är att låna ut allmänt stöd till verksamheten vid OHCHR kontor i Colombia.

The Government of Sweden has confirmed its intention to support the operations of the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights in Colombia (2017-2021) with a total contribution of SEK 62 600 000. The overall aim of contribution will be to lend general support to the operations of OHCHR’s Office in Colombia.

Summary of Results
OHCHR monitored the situation and supported cases of human rights violations during the National Strike that began on 28 April and lasted for over three months. The Office also accompanied the meetings between the Civic Strike Committee, the national Government, and youth with local administrations and with the national Government. As a result, the Office was able to present a Lessons learned document.
The JEP incorporated the gender-based approach and promoted the possible opening of a national macro-case on sexual and reproductive violence and violence based on the sexual identity of the victims.
OHCHR supported the spaces for social dialogue to promote the network of institutional and civil society allies for non-recurrence, through live actions in the regions with the methodological support and sponsorship of 11 territorial interventions and regional dialogues.
OHCHR supported spaces for inter-institutional consensus building and coordination that contributed to strengthening the search processes in the territories and sponsored nine pacts.
The contribution by the Office to the High Commissioners report on violence and excessive use of force against Afro-descendants by public security forces, in the context of Human Rights Council Resolution 41.3.3
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
